Constructs and indicators commonly included in surveys as part of FSN surveillance
Food security
Household food security commonly refers to the adequacy (real or perceived) of the food available to meet the needs of the house-
hold members, taking into consideration cultural and personal preferences (Pinstrup-Andersen, 2009). The Household Hunger
